run_flop_analysis: run flop count analysis on a Detectron2 model using a config file and test data
run_activation_analysis: run activation count analysis on a Detectron2 model to measure operator activations
run_parameter_analysis: run parameter count analysis on a Detectron2 model to show total parameters
run_structure_analysis: run model structure analysis to print the Detectron2 model architecture
setup_config: setup a Detectron2 configuration from a YAML or LazyConfig file with overrides
